theses.subject: Big Pharma
theses.thesis: Big Pharma is the highest-scoring ELIGIBLE theme, and it is the only eligible theme with a combination of strong trend-health (durability 0.78), high participation (breadth 0.889), and a confirming trend tag. The one validated edge in this detector is the absolute-trend gate for staying-power/drawdown control, and Big Pharma passes that gate.
